主要内容: On February 25, 2013, Kentucky Bank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kentucky Bancshares, Inc., announced plans to expand its presence in the Central Kentucky market with the opening of a new branch office in downtown Lexington, Kentucky. The new office would be in leased space located at 360 East Vine Street Suite 100 in Lexington. The new Lexington branch, the opening of which is subject to regulatory approval, is anticipated to open by May 2013.
